programRules.name: ANC - Hide and clear Syphilis 2nd result, titre and test type when date not entered
programRules.description: Hides and clears the Syphilis 2nd Test Result, Test Type, and Titre fields when no 2nd syphilis test date has been recorded.

programRules.name: ANC - Display HIV 1st test status - result
programRules.description: Displays the actual HIV 1st test result in the Program Indicator Widget once both date and result are recorded.
programRules.condition: d2:hasValue(#{ANC HIV1 Test Date}) && d2:hasValue(#{ANC HIV1 Result})

programRules.name: ANC - Warn if patient is overdue for next visit
programRules.description: Shows a warning on the Scheduled Date of Next Visit field when the scheduled date has passed and no subsequent visit has been recorded (patient overdue).
programRules.condition: d2:hasValue(#{ANC Scheduled Next Visit}) && #{ANC Scheduled Next Visit} <= V{current_date}

programRules.name: ANC - Display Syphilis 1st test status - result
programRules.description: Displays the actual Syphilis 1st test result in the Program Indicator Widget once both date and result are recorded.
programRules.condition: d2:hasValue(#{ANC Syphilis1 Test Date}) && d2:hasValue(#{ANC 1st Syphilis test result})

programRules.name: ANC - Hide 2nd syphilis test type if 2nd test date is empty
programRules.description: Hides the 2nd Syphilis Test Type field when no 2nd syphilis test date has been recorded. Redundant safety rule alongside jzOHUG2xa4V.

programRules.name: ANC - Warn Syphilis 2nd result missing
programRules.description: Shows a warning on the Syphilis 2nd Test Result field reminding the user to enter the result when a test date has been recorded but no result is present.
programRules.condition: d2:hasValue(#{ANC Syphilis2 Test Date}) && !d2:hasValue(#{ANC 2nd syphilis test result})

programRules.name: ANC - Warn HIV 1st result missing
programRules.description: Shows a warning on the HIV 1st Test Result field reminding the user to enter the result when a test date has been recorded but no result is present.
programRules.condition: d2:hasValue(#{ANC HIV1 Test Date}) && !d2:hasValue(#{ANC HIV1 Result})

programRules.name: ANC - Show current gestational age in combo text
programRules.description: Assembles the current gestational age display string (e.g. '24 weeks 3 days') from the calculated weeks and days, for use in the DISPLAYKEYVALUEPAIR widget.

programRules.name: ANC - GTT High Value Warning
programRules.description: Show error when GTT screening result is above 6

programRules.name: ANC - Hide 3rd syphilis treatment details if 3rd treatment date empty
programRules.description: Hides the 3rd Syphilis Treatment Details field until the 3rd Syphilis Treatment Date is entered.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide and clear Hep B 1st result when date not entered
programRules.description: Hides and clears the Hepatitis B 1st Test Result field when no 1st Hepatitis B test date has been recorded.

programRules.name: ANC - Warn Syphilis 1st result missing
programRules.description: Shows a warning on the Syphilis 1st Test Result field reminding the user to enter the result when a test date has been recorded but no result is present.
programRules.condition: d2:hasValue(#{ANC Syphilis1 Test Date}) && !d2:hasValue(#{ANC 1st Syphilis test result})

programRules.name: ANC - Hide 1st syphilis test type if 1st test date is empty
programRules.description: Hides the 1st Syphilis Test Type field when no 1st syphilis test date has been recorded. Redundant safety rule alongside iKM42hHjOGc.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide 1st syphilis titre fields if 1st test not reactive
programRules.description: Hides the 1st syphilis titre fields when neither the initial screening result nor the repeat confirmatory result is Reactive.
programRules.condition: !(#{ANC 1st syphilis test result} == 'Reactive') && !(#{ANC Repeat1 syphilis test result} == 'Reactive')

programRules.name: ANC - Calculate LMP from EDD
programRules.description: Calculates the Last Menstrual Period date by back-calculating from the Estimated Date of Delivery when LMP is not directly entered.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide all syphilis treatment fields if neither test reactive
programRules.description: Hides all syphilis treatment fields (Drug Given, all treatment dates and details) when neither the 1st nor 2nd syphilis test result is Reactive.
programRules.condition: !(#{ANC 1st syphilis test result} == 'Reactive') && !(#{ANC 2nd syphilis test result} == 'Reactive')

programRules.name: ANC - Hide and clear Syphilis 1st result, titre and test type when date not entered
programRules.description: Hides and clears the Syphilis 1st Test Result, Test Type, and Titre fields when no 1st syphilis test date has been recorded.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide repeat 2nd syphilis test fields when 2nd result not reactive
programRules.description: Hides the repeat (confirmatory) syphilis test Date, Type, and Result fields for the 2nd test when the initial 2nd screening result is not Reactive.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide 'Partner Tested for Syphilis' field if syphilis result negative
programRules.description: Hides the Partner Tested for Syphilis and Partner Treated for Syphilis fields when the patient's 1st syphilis test result is not Reactive.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide 2nd syphilis titre fields if 2nd test not reactive
programRules.description: Hides the 2nd syphilis titre fields when neither the initial 2nd screening result nor the repeat 2nd confirmatory result is Reactive.
programRules.condition: !(#{ANC 2nd syphilis test result} == 'Reactive') && !(#{ANC Repeat2 syphilis test result} == 'Reactive')

programRules.name: ANC - Hide 'Partner Tested for Chlamydia' field if chlamydia result negative
programRules.description: Hides the Partner Tested for Chlamydia and Partner Treated for Chlamydia fields when the patient's chlamydia result is not Positive.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide and clear HIV 1st result when date not entered
programRules.description: Hides and clears the HIV 1st Test Result field when no HIV 1st test date has been recorded.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide repeat 1st syphilis test fields when 1st result not reactive
programRules.description: Hides the repeat (confirmatory) syphilis test Date, Type, and Result fields for the 1st test when the initial screening result is not Reactive.

programRules.name: ANC - Warn Hep B 1st result missing
programRules.description: Shows a warning on the Hepatitis B 1st Test Result field reminding the user to enter the result when a test date has been recorded but no result is present.
programRules.condition: d2:hasValue(#{ANC HepB1 Test Date}) && !d2:hasValue(#{ANC HepB1 Result})

programRules.name: ANC - Display current gestational age
programRules.description: Displays the current gestational age (weeks and days) in the Program Indicator Widget as a key/value pair, calculated in real time from LMP.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide and clear Hep B 2nd result when date not entered
programRules.description: Hides and clears the Hepatitis B 2nd Test Result field when no 2nd Hepatitis B test date has been recorded.

programRules.name: ANC - Display Syphilis 1st test status - pending
programRules.description: Displays 'Pending result' status for the Syphilis 1st test in the Program Indicator Widget when a test date is recorded but no result yet.
programRules.condition: d2:hasValue(#{ANC Syphilis1 Test Date}) && !d2:hasValue(#{ANC 1st Syphilis test result})

programRules.name: ANC - Hide repeat 1st syphilis test type and result when date empty
programRules.description: Shows the repeat 1st syphilis Test Type and Result fields only after the repeat test date is entered (cascading field visibility).

programRules.name: ANC - Display Hepatitis B 1st test status - pending
programRules.description: Displays 'Pending result' status for the Hepatitis B 1st test in the Program Indicator Widget when a test date is recorded but no result yet.
programRules.condition: d2:hasValue(#{ANC HepB1 Test Date}) && !d2:hasValue(#{ANC HepB1 Result})

programRules.name: ANC - Hide 2nd syphilis treatment fields if 1st treatment date empty
programRules.description: Hides the 2nd Syphilis Treatment Date and Details fields until the 1st Syphilis Treatment Date is entered, ensuring sequential treatment entry.

programRules.name: ANC - Display Syphilis 1st test status - not done
programRules.description: Displays 'Not done' status for the Syphilis 1st test in the Program Indicator Widget when no test date has been recorded.

programRules.name: ANC - Calculate Gestational Age at Booking from LMP
programRules.description: Calculates the Estimated Date of Delivery and Gestational Age in weeks from the Last Menstrual Period date.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide repeat 2nd syphilis test type and result when date empty
programRules.description: Shows the repeat 2nd syphilis Test Type and Result fields only after the repeat test date is entered (cascading field visibility).

programRules.name: ANC - Hide 2nd syphilis treatment details if 2nd treatment date empty
programRules.description: Hides the 2nd Syphilis Treatment Details field until the 2nd Syphilis Treatment Date is entered.

programRules.name: ANC - Calculate GA remainder days from LMP
programRules.description: Calculates the Gestational Age remainder days from the Last Menstrual Period date.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide and clear HIV 2nd result when date not entered
programRules.description: Hides and clears the HIV 2nd Test Result field when no HIV 2nd test date has been recorded.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide 1st syphilis treatment details if 1st treatment date empty
programRules.description: Hides the 1st Syphilis Treatment Details field until the 1st Syphilis Treatment Date is entered.

programRules.name: ANC - Display Hepatitis B 1st test status - not done
programRules.description: Displays 'Not done' status for the Hepatitis B 1st test in the Program Indicator Widget when no test date has been recorded.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide 'Partner Tested for Gonorrhoea' field if gonorrhoea result negative
programRules.description: Hides the Partner Tested for Gonorrhoea and Partner Treated for Gonorrhoea fields when the patient's gonorrhoea result is not Positive.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide 3rd syphilis treatment fields if 2nd treatment date empty
programRules.description: Hides the 3rd Syphilis Treatment Date and Details fields until the 2nd Syphilis Treatment Date is entered, ensuring sequential treatment entry.

programRules.name: ANC - Display HIV 1st test status - not done
programRules.description: Displays 'Not done' status for the HIV 1st test in the Program Indicator Widget when no test date has been recorded.

programRules.name: ANC - Hide 'Partner Test Result' field if partner not tested for HIV
programRules.description: Hides the Partner HIV Result field when the Partner Tested for HIV field is false or not filled in.
programRules.condition: #{ANC Partner Tested for HIV} == false  || !d2:hasValue( #{ANC Partner Tested for HIV} )

programRules.name: ANC - Display HIV 1st test status - pending
programRules.description: Displays 'Pending result' status for the HIV 1st test in the Program Indicator Widget when a test date is recorded but no result yet.
programRules.condition: d2:hasValue(#{ANC HIV1 Test Date}) && !d2:hasValue(#{ANC HIV1 Result})

programRules.name: ANC - Warn HIV 2nd result missing
programRules.description: Shows a warning on the HIV 2nd Test Result field reminding the user to enter the result when a test date has been recorded but no result is present.
programRules.condition: d2:hasValue(#{ANC HIV2 Test Date}) && !d2:hasValue(#{ANC HIV2 Result})

programRules.name: ANC - Warn Hep B 2nd result missing
programRules.description: Shows a warning on the Hepatitis B 2nd Test Result field reminding the user to enter the result when a test date has been recorded but no result is present.
programRules.condition: d2:hasValue(#{ANC HepB2 Test Date}) && !d2:hasValue(#{ANC HepB2 Result})

programRules.name: ANC - Display Hepatitis B 1st test status - result
programRules.description: Displays the actual Hepatitis B 1st test result in the Program Indicator Widget once both date and result are recorded.
programRules.condition: d2:hasValue(#{ANC HepB1 Test Date}) && d2:hasValue(#{ANC HepB1 Result})
